name: OlogyCrew
description: Service scheduling and booking platform. 48+ categories of service providers including audio visual crew, barbers, DJs, fitness trainers, photographers, handymen, and more. Providers list services with pricing and availability. Customers browse, book, and pay.

search_services.description: Search for services by keyword, category, location, or price range

get_provider.description: Get a provider's full profile including services, categories, and availability

check_availability.description: Check a provider's available time slots for a specific date

parameters.serviceId: Optional service ID to check duration-specific slots

list_categories.description: List all service categories with service counts
